title: Aayan X & Wack 100 Expose Benzino On Clubhouse [Listen]
htmlContent:

Aayan, a popular social media influencer, and famous YouTuber, first broke the story in the “AAYAN FIX MY LIFE” club on the clubhouse app. Audio leaked from a conversation between Benzino and Wack100 rocked the Meta world. Apparently, Zino, who’s now being referred to by fans as “Gayzino,” has come out of the closet during these clips.

An unknown transgender explained how Benzino called them at 2 am one morning with a suggestion. He was with a stripper in his room as he expressed one of his wildest fantasies. He explained how he has always wanted to have a ménage à trois, also known as a three sum, involving a woman and a trans. Supposedly it happens at a Red Roof Inn motel in Atlanta. Zino told Wack 100 he had a 3-inch vibrator with two women in a room. However, Aayan says the webcam video clip he has shows no women in the room. It clearly indicates Benzino as the man in the video playing in his anus.

For those who can’t remember. His Baby mother, back in 2020, exposed DMs between him and transgender. Not his first time around the block!
